long_biography.plain_text:
When a customer asked machinery supplier Rich Frain to rent equipment, his first instinct was to think of his business as a seller. The customer wanted to test an unproven product before committing to equipment. Frain asked his team why they could not accommodate the request and introduced a rental service.

He also co-wrote Secrets of Buying Packaging Machinery with John R. Henry. The guide follows an equipment purchase from the initial idea through finance, supplier selection, acceptance testing and installation. It also addresses training and continuing support once machinery is running.
